segments.text: V. 25. And if you ſerve GOD, you need be careful for nothing. Therefore take not thought—That is, be not anxiouſly careful. Beware of worldly cares; for theſe are as inconſiſtent with the true Service of GOD as worldly Deſires. Is not the Life more than meat?—And if GOD give the greater Gift, will He deny the ſmaller?
